title: 融雪脈衝與蓄量帳~Snowmelt pulses and storage

title: 水位溫度與位移殘差~Level temperature and displacement residuals

title: 名目停留時間與水齡~Nominal residence and water age

title: 曲面水平投影的水推力~Hydrostatic horizontal projected force

title: 颱風入流與短時水位~Storm inflow and short term level
boundary: 三小時淨入流與水面積固定，沒有指定實際蓄洪空間或放流規則~Constant net inflow and surface area for three hours, without specifying real flood space or release rules

title: 原水保守溶質混合~Conservative raw water mixing

title: 含水率與壓實乾密度~Water content and compacted density

title: 快速降水位與孔壓滯後~Drawdown and pore pressure lag

title: 地震慣性力的受力帳~Seismic inertia force bookkeeping
boundary: 無因次係數為假想值，只求等效水平慣性力，未選定設計地震~The coefficient is hypothetical and dimensionless; only equivalent horizontal inertia is calculated, without selecting a design earthquake

title: 後池吸收放流變化~Afterbay absorption of release changes
